onboarding.tagline: Investing looks like a dark forest.
onboarding.heroBody: Learn investing without the fear: every number inflation-adjusted, every suggestion explained step by step, every decision still yours.

realReturn.title: Real Returns, After Inflation
realReturn.desc: "I gained 300%" means you lost if inflation was 320%. Lumos deflates every figure with official data before showing it.

realEstate.title: Real Estate and Stocks, Side by Side
realEstate.desc: Price per m² and real appreciation for 81 provinces, next to your stock portfolio. Rent or buy — the math lives here.

panic.title: There When You Panic
panic.desc: The most expensive mistake is selling in a crash. When markets drop, one tap brings a calm, data-grounded voice.

onboarding.expectation: Lumos guides you; you trade at your own broker, then we track it here together. We never trade on your behalf.
onboarding.disclaimerLine: <0>Educational purposes only.</0> Not investment advice. Consult a licensed financial advisor.

disclaimerModal.title: What Lumos does — and doesn't
disclaimerModal.doesBody: builds your risk profile, computes a portfolio allocation that fits it, deflates every number with live market and official inflation data, and explains the formula behind each decision.
disclaimerModal.doesntBody: trade on your behalf or hold your money. It provides no investment advice, financial planning, or any regulated financial service.
disclaimerModal.detail: The portfolio suggestions this app produces are based on public market data and AI analysis. They should never be the sole basis of any investment decision. Always consult a licensed financial advisor before investing.
disclaimerModal.checkbox: I understand this app is educational only and does not constitute investment advice.
